CAMEL-16019.title: Create another Camel Paho component for MQTT 5 support
CAMEL-16019.description:
Current camel-paho uses MQTT v3 client library. We need a camel-paho version that uses [MQTT v5 client library|https://github.com/eclipse/paho.mqtt.java/tree/v1.2.5/org.eclipse.paho.mqttv5.client] so that we can use MQTT 5 with Camel.

About the component name: which one do we prefer?
- camel-paho5
- camel-paho-mqtt5
- anything else

commits.message: CAMEL-16019: Create another Camel Paho component for MQTT 5 support
commits.author: tadayosi

CAMEL-16584.title: YAML Dsl : support for route template
CAMEL-16584.description:
The YAMl DSL does not yet support route template, we should add support for it, something like:

{code:yaml}
- template: 
    beans:
      - name: myBean
        type: com.acme.MyBean
        properties:
         foo: "bar"
    from:
      uri: direct:start
      steps:
        - process: "myBean"
{code}

commits.message: CAMEL-16584 support for route template in YAML DSL
commits.author: lburgazzoli
